analysis: Examined base-side protocol-messages.md lines 583-1257 (capacity telemetry, service reservation release, inference frames, attestation responses, model_autopilot_status, prefetch_model_status, models_replace, prefix-cache receipts v1/v2, capacity_quote, inference_request, autopilot command/control, load/prefetch). These are base text; the head changes per file_changes are documentation: a Swift-only optional `detail` field on model_autopilot_status (head 854) carrying a closed busy reason or `autopilot_operation`, and a closed `error` vocabulary for Autopilot downloads in prefetch_model_status (head 877-896: model_not_selected, autopilot_paused, model_not_supported, model_limit_reached...). These describe diagnostic, closed-enum fields with no prompt content, no authorization or capacity grant (status alone never changes scheduler capacity per base 854/856-861). Other head ranges (1230, 1279-1294, 1380-1519) were not visible in these units and must be reviewed in other batches; base ranges 1257-1258, 1344, 1372-1416, 1444 also outside these units. No regression identified against T-041 (prefix-cache receipts unchanged here), TB-011/T-052/T-053 (no change to authorization semantics visible), or T-058 (new detail field is closed vocabulary, not stable identity). Integration question: confirm head text for autopilot download (head 1279-1294) does not let a coordinator command trigger downloads without consent or bypass the selected-model allowlist (ModelAutopilotPolicy.rejection), and that `detail`/`error` strings stay closed and non-identifying.
